title: Higher direct images commute with bounded-below filtered colimits
statement:
Let $f\colon X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] that is quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Let $\mathcal R$ be a sheaf of rings on $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $(K_i^\bullet)$ be a filtered diagram [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of $\mathcal R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] on $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ vanishing
below a fixed degree $a$. Then for every $q$ the canonical map
$\varinjlim_iR^qf_*K_i^\bullet\to R^qf_*(\varinjlim_iK_i^\bullet)$, with $f_*$ as in [det-pe-topos-functoriality-inverse-image] and $R f_*$ as in [def-sfb-right-derived-functor], is an isomorphism of
sheaves on $Y_{\mathrm{proét}}$.

proof.text: Use boundedRingModuleDirectImage_hasKInjectiveResolutions from [lem-pe-bounded-complex-direct-image-presheaf] to prove resolution existence. For each complex L with the common lower bound, use the explicitly constructed inverseImageCohomologyPresheaf and boundedComplexDirectImagePresheafIso of that same node. Its naturality theorem supplies the comparison of diagrams and cocones. The ring module direct image and its bounded variant are definitionally the same pushforward along proEtaleBaseChange; their derived versions coincide by proof irrelevance of the resolution-existence witness.

For an affine pro-etale object V of Y, apply [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs] and base-change permanence [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence] to the literal pullback V ×_Y X, the underlying scheme of proEtaleBaseChange f at V. The projection to V is qcqs, hence this pullback is qcqs. These are the existing Mathlib instances and permanence theorems; the packaged topos-functoriality theorem is not needed.

The evaluation functors on module complexes preserve colimits. Their image of the colimit cocone is a colimit of zero objects below a, hence the colimit also has the same lower bound. Put P = inverseImageCohomologyPresheaf f R q and take the canonical presheaf comparison colimit.post D P. Evaluation preserves colimits, and colimit.post_post identifies evaluation of this comparison with [det-pe-bounded-continuity-sections] at the qcqs pullback. Cancel the invertible evaluation comparison to conclude invertibility on affine objects. Module-sheaf forgetting preserves colimits and reflects isomorphisms by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful].

source.place: Second paragraph, comparison on affine objects

proof.text: For every pro-etale object use its ordinary affine open cover, which is a pro-etale covering by Scheme.ProEt.mem_topology_of_openImmersion. Invertibility on affine sources gives local injectivity using equalizer sieves and local surjectivity using image sieves. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-iso-locally-bijective], specifically topology.W_of_isLocallyBijective and W_iff. Abelian presheaf sheafification is a left adjoint and therefore preserves colimits directly by Mathlib. The common lower bound for the termwise colimit permits [lem-pe-bounded-complex-direct-image-presheaf]. Its naturality identifies the sheafified presheaf cocone, with vertex comparison A.map φ followed by the natural direct-image isomorphism, with the higher-direct-image cocone. The module forgetful functor preserves the relevant colimit by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful] and reflects isomorphisms, hence reflects that colimit. Uniqueness of colimits proves invertibility of the original canonical colimit.desc.

source.place: Second paragraph, affine covers and sheafification

lean.statement: theorem boundedContinuityDirectImage {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (R : Sheaf (topology X) RingCat.{u + 1}) {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (D : I ⥤ CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u + 1} R) ℤ) (a : ℤ) (hD : ∀ i : I, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a → IsZero ((D.obj i).X n)) (q : ℤ) : IsIso (colimit.desc ((D ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) ⋙ ringHigherDirectImage f R q) ((ringHigherDirectImage f R q).mapCocone (DerivedCategory.Q.mapCocone (colimit.cocone D))))
lean.note: Module direct image over f_*R is SheafOfModules.pushforward along proEtaleBaseChange (= MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @WeaklyEtale ⊤ f, the base change u of det-pe-topos-functoriality-inverse-image) with identity coefficient map; R f_* is the recorded rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions (def-sfb-right-derived-functor). ringModuleDirectImage_hasKInjectiveResolutions is the named postponed helper (K-injective resolutions for arbitrary RingCat coefficient sheaves on the pro-etale site, Stacks 07A5/079P) needed by that interface; stage 3 proves it with the item. Maintainer fix: the index category is V-small, I : Type (u + 1) as in def-weil-size-convention and det-pe-bounded-continuity-sections (was Type u), and the redundant [HasColimit D] hypothesis is dropped (the colimit is inferred).
